protocol.population: player-games a player appeared in, ≥ 3 earlier games, ≥ 12 recent minutes (props on a player who does not play are void)

tracks.P: projected: teammates missing judged from the previous game; the player's own role from his history
tracks.C: confirmed: tonight's starters and who is active, known ~30 min before tip

protocol.lines: synthetic lines (no licensed historical prop prices): the half-point nearest the mean, and a fixed alternate-line ladder per family (LADDER)

market.market_reason: no licensed archive of timestamped closing prices is on file; archived untimestamped lines are not a market test
